runs.sql:
SELECT SUM(BD.CASH_BALANCE) AS TOTAL_CASH
FROM FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER C
JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT A ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY BD ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = BD.ACCOUNT_ID
WHERE C.CUSTOMER_NAME = '신예은'
  AND BD.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY)

WITH LATEST AS (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) AS MAX_DATE FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY)

JOIN FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY B ON A.ACCOUNT_ID = B.ACCOUNT_ID

WHERE C.CUSTOMER_NAME = '신예은'
GROUP BY C.CUSTOMER_NAME

WHERE B.BRANCH_NAME = '부산지점' AND E.ORDER_ID IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UNFILLED_ORDER_COUNT
